attempts.raw: {"risk": 5, "reason": "Massive overhaul of the core Resources module's asset build pipeline and ResourceManagementOptionsConfiguration.cs (which registers script/style paths, versions, and CDN fallbacks used by every module and theme), including vendored library moves/renames (fontawesome, jquery-ui, monaco, vue) and bundled JS/CSS regeneration, so any path/version mismatch or missed reference update would break scripts/styles admin-wide across all tenants and dependent applications."

{"risk": 5, "reason": "This is a massive overhaul of the OrchardCore.Resources build pipeline and vendored assets (jQuery, jQuery UI, Bootstrap, Vue moved to vue-2.6.14 vendor path plus new toolchain for Vue 3, FontAwesome path moved from wwwroot to Assets, Monaco/CodeMirror files regenerated, and an 850+ line rewrite of ResourceManagementOptionsConfiguration.cs which defines nearly every shared script/style resource path/version used by every module and every downstream site) — any path, filename, or version mismatch here breaks core admin UI, editors, and third-party themes/modules referencing these well-known resource names across all tenants."

{"risk": 5, "reason": "Massive overhaul of the frontend build pipeline and core OrchardCore.Resources module (Assets.json reshuffled, jQuery/Bootstrap/FontAwesome/Vue vendor files relocated from wwwroot to Assets with build-time copy, ResourceManagementOptionsConfiguration.cs changed by ~850/-207 lines, and prep for Vue 3) which affects resource paths/CDN fallbacks and script tag ordering used by virtually every tenant, theme, and module across the CMS, so any path mismatch or resource-name regression would break admin UI and front-end rendering site-wide."
